name: browser_new_tab
description: Open a URL in a new tab in an existing Chrome profile window without launching CLI processes. Supports targeting 'devops@qtloads.com' (or 'devops') or 'jayantdahiya1204@gmail.com' (or 'default').

active.description: Whether to activate the new tab. Defaults to true.

profile.description: Profile to open tab in: 'devops@qtloads.com', 'devops', 'qtloads', 'jayantdahiya1204@gmail.com', or 'default'.

url.description: The destination URL. Defaults to about:blank.
